description: Read a group channel's posts in seq order since a cursor (default: your own last read position, or 0 for a first read). ack: true stores next_cursor as your new read position. A non-member gets channel_not_found.

ack.description: Store next_cursor as your new read position.

channel_id.description: The group channel's id, from host.channel.open(group=...).

cursor.description: Read posts with seq greater than this; omit to resume from your own stored cursor.

limit.description: Max posts to return; default 50, max 100.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.channel.read
